invoice_kind.description: What the document is, from its heading.

currency.description: The currency the amounts are in.

gstin_shown.description: A GSTIN (Indian GST registration number) is printed.

paid_stamp.description: A red PAID stamp is on the page.

signature_present.description: The authorised signatory line carries a handwritten signature.

qr_code_present.description: A QR code is printed on the page.

bank_details_present.description: Bank account details for payment are printed.

discount_applied.description: A discount line is shown above the total.

line_items_count.description: How many line items the table lists (1 to 10).

tax_type.description: Which tax is applied: CGST + SGST, IGST, VAT, or none.
